question: What proper motion of the thumbs creates the mudrā described as fish-formed?
premises: Both thumbs are to be moved.
The movement must be done properly.
The resulting mudrā has the form of a fish.
inference: Properly moving both thumbs produces the matsyarūpiṇī mudrā.
plain_english: One should properly move both thumbs; this mudrā takes the form of a fish.
